title: stainless steel cookie scoops
text: stainless steel cookie scoops. These are quite the "fancy" scoops.  I purchased for a cookie project and use the largest one for portion control of ice cream.  They are stainless steel and fairly heavy.  They note they are dishwasher safe - I have been hand washing.  They came with quite fancy blue velvet like pouches with functioning draw strings.  In using the the scoops they cleanly scoop, are fairly heavy.  However, be careful not to get too close the end of the ratchet type action as I have pinched my hand numerous times. A side from that, I think this are nice, quality scoops that used carefully will probably last as long as I will be using them.  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.
